en.name: Sergius III
en.summary: A pope restored to power by force who annulled the Formosan ordinations he had once opposed and whose reign opened the era later called the 'pornocracy.'
en.body: Sergius III seized the papacy with the armed backing of the powerful Roman noblewoman Theophylact and her family, reportedly having his predecessor and rival Leo V's captor, the antipope Christopher, imprisoned and killed. He reversed the earlier rehabilitation of Formosus, again declaring his ordinations invalid. His reign is traditionally seen as opening a period of the papacy dominated by the scheming of powerful Roman aristocratic families, later moralized by historians as the 'pornocracy' or rule of the harlots.
